name: Nabisco Richmond Biscuit Bakery - Richmond VA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Internal truck gate inside the property: chain-link fencing crosses the truck driveway ~150m in from S Laburnum Ave, with a gate where the drive meets the fenced trailer/dock yard (z21 imagery at 37.4947,-77.3551). The road-edge driveway entrance itself is open (no road-side barrier).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white/brown-roofed 1-2 vehicle-footprint structure beside the internal gate (visible z21 at 37.4943,-77.3551) - consistent with a staffed guard booth controlling truck-yard access.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long entrance driveway runs ~150m from S Laburnum Ave intersection along the south building face before reaching the gated yard - ample queue depth for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved driveway apron and large open yard area at the internal gate; physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated west-side drop yard with many trailers parked in marked rows (z19 at 37.4950,-77.3555); estimate 55+ trailers visible, capacity ~90.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks with trailers backed in along the south face of the main building; estimate ~40 doors, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Three distinct buildings on the property: the main ~1M sq ft bakery, a connected north wing, and a separate brown-roof building at the south.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in overhead imagery; left low-confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single shared in/out gate; outbound lane count not separately determinable.
